reason: Adds timer-driven cache eviction using :erlang.send_after and handle_info, including rescheduling and process state handling; removes policy-specific supervisor child specifications.
Adds strict process-manager start/continue routing and changes instance startup/reuse and callback stop/error handling. These change process lifecycle and coordination.

The issue and added atomic-update test concern negating validation conditions. Process.get/put/delete are existing process-local error storage; changed arithmetic and argument passing fix error counts without changing process ownership, messaging or lifecycle. Process-local bookkeeping alone is excluded under the clarified semantic rubric.
adjudication_basis: Assistant re-review of reference patch, issue description and reference test changes; no execution.

reason: Changes pool process identity: derives a default pool_id from the worker module, uses it in GenServer registration and child_spec identity, and updates metrics lookup.
Implements tuple parsing, translation and type inference. The Supervisor.start_child change is formatting only, with no changed supervision behavior; it caused a keyword false positive.
Adds a marked_to_copy? GenServer request and server-state query to make copying idempotent and preserve existing stubs. The server request protocol changes substantively.
Adds configurable process-manager idle timeouts, propagates options through startup, returns callback timeout values, and stops normally on the timeout message.
Adds stream-specific event subscriptions, changes subscription requests/state, and filters delivery to subscribers by stream. This changes interprocess message routing.

Changes generator config insertion and generated form handling, with formatting/type cleanup. Supervisor references occur in formatting/type changes; there is no substantive supervision or process-lifecycle change.
Tracks pending acknowledgements by event number and resumes pending-event processing only when the relevant recipients have acknowledged. This changes message coordination.
Adds host_display_name configuration and enriches reported host attributes. Agent refers to the New Relic product in prose, not an Elixir Agent process change.

Mixed patch: the issue primarily adds correlation/causation metadata, but event-handler and process-router acknowledgement helpers now require :ok from EventStore and Subscriptions. Previously a non-:ok first result was ignored; now it raises and prevents the next acknowledgement. This substantively changes failure behavior in event-processing processes, qualifying under the any-substantive-process-change patch rubric. This does not establish that the main issue or tests require OTP reasoning.
adjudication_basis: Assistant re-review of reference patch, issue description and reference test changes; no execution.

reason: Runs required cache warmers synchronously before optional asynchronous warmers, changing cache startup readiness and blocking behavior; also removes temporary validation setup.

Adds message injection through a producer query handled by the server and changes GenStage consumer exception handling/acknowledgement to avoid crashes. Process interaction and failure handling are substantive.
Implements strong-consistency subscriptions with a GenServer, monitors, acknowledgements, send/receive waits, timeouts and timer cleanup, and adds the subscription server to supervision.
Fixes a cache-computation race by rechecking the cached value before spawning a linked computation, and distinguishes immediate replies from pending listener notification.

Alongside compiler type changes, changes CodeServer deferred replies and waiting-request handling, including replying with an error instead of starting another asynchronous compilation for a missing function.
Changes worker supervision/restart behavior and timeout handling, and returns checked-out workers through GenServer.cast in an after block even when work fails.
Replaces Registry.unregister with unregister_match using doc_id, preserving other registrations under the same field key. This changes process subscription registration semantics.
Changes warmer process names/identities, child startup and supervisor-child lookup so warm requests reach the appropriate warmer PID.

Rescues process-manager state-mutation exceptions and routes them through the error handler instead of persisting/acknowledging as on success. Callback continuation and failure behavior change even without a regex marker.
Changes hidden form input configuration/rendering and date-builder syntax. No substantive process behavior is changed.
Changes compile-time router forwarding validation and module/alias handling, plus JavaScript and documentation cleanup. No runtime process coordination or lifecycle change.
Changes secure HTTP response-header defaults and merging so explicitly supplied headers are preserved. No process behavior change.
Distinguishes an absent schema key from a present key with nil during validation. This is data-validation logic.
Adds if/else parsing, type checking and Erlang AST translation. This is compiler expression handling, not process behavior.
Allows doc: false through option validation and suppresses documentation for that option. No process behavior change.
Adds record-pattern parsing to the compiler grammar. No process behavior change.
Extracts the :let! argument and attaches it as the default slot parameter in the template AST. No process behavior change.
Adds GraphQL federation interfaceObject notation/directive generation and compatibility examples, plus build/config changes. No substantive OTP process behavior change.

Adds an optional dispatch execution-result payload containing aggregate identity and produced events. The change concerns returned application data, not scheduling, acknowledgements, registration or process lifecycle.
Parses rediss URIs into ssl: true client options and adds a stunnel Docker fixture. This is connection configuration, not process coordination or supervision.
Delimits temporary formatting placeholders on both sides to prevent replacement collisions. Pure string transformation.
Preserves inline attribute-list source text when it follows a non-tag AST value. Markdown parsing/rendering logic.
Validates that command/router modules exist at compile time and improves errors; also updates release/CI metadata. Module registration here is compile-time routing, not process registration.
Cleans exception interpolation variables and preserves field-validation error metadata. No process behavior change.
Changes router forwarding and verified-route generation, templates, asset tooling and formatting. Added clustering/supervision text is documentation only; it does not implement changed OTP behavior.
Adds tuple expressions and return types across parsing, AST translation and type inference. No process behavior change.
Detects migration-looking .ex files and warns instead of executing them as .exs migrations. File discovery/validation logic.
Adds calculation callback return validation and richer comparison/nil validation, with filter error propagation. These are application validation callbacks, not OTP server callbacks.
